scope: 名指ししたRustの結果と除外理由。Rust/Leanの同じ受理や理由の一致へ算入しない

cases.name: class-structural
cases.target: trait versus implementation effect declaration of class-structural
cases.reason: Rust compares implementation and trait effect declarations structurally; Lean checks method body coverage under the trait declaration

cases.name: nul-direct
cases.target: the direct hostPattern literal of nul-direct only
cases.reason: Only the condition literal beginning U+0000 and followed by integer spelling; Rust retains a String argument and rejects its host spelling, while Lean absArg forgets that literal

cases.name: nul-dynamic
cases.reason: Local string condition is statically unknown and accepted at Top; runtime spelling check remains
